scope: Prepared Board application with an HTTP canonical bridge fixture; no live Nautilo account or provider
checks: real native typing holds autosave, stable header/context, explicit Save commits exact canonical bytes
fresh page reopen renders the persisted native board without a write
unsupported image is refused before changing the model or dirty Human lease
decode failure leaves canonical bytes, revision and clean Human state unchanged
pending real image refuses Save/close, journals exact:false, then saves exact bytes once after release
reader abort and reader error leave canonical bytes, revision and writes unchanged
reload during pending image restores the inexact journal in conflict without writing canonical bytes
Ivory and Tokyo palette changes preserve canonical bytes
concurrent canonical update preserves active Human text and saves an exact separate copy
read-only native preview renders canonical content without Save or close-write registration
